newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Taihan passes on 5,000T rapeseed tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Taihan passes on 5,000T rapeseed tender.

text.p: South Korea's Taihan Sugar Corp said on Wednesday it had passed on tenders for 5,000 tonnes of Chinese rapeseed meal due to high prices.
A Taihan official said the lowest bid was made by Toepfer at $157 a tonne on a cost and freight basis.
"It was higher than expected," the official said.
The official said the tender had been invited on Tuesday by its Hongkong branch office for shipment in December.
He said the company would invite the tender again but declined to give further details.
